title: Missed Garbage Pickups
description: Residents in Zones 3 & 7 report 40% of scheduled pickups are missed, leading to overflowing bins and public health complaints. Manual tracking has failed to resolve the issue.

title: Water Supply Interruptions
description: Average water supply interruption lasts 8 hours per incident. Residents face 3–4 such incidents per month. Need real-time pipe monitoring and predictive maintenance.

title: Streetlight Outage Response Time
description: Reported streetlight faults take an average of 6 days to be resolved. Night safety incidents near dark zones have increased 22% in the last year.

title: Pothole Repair Turnaround
description: Citizen-reported potholes take an average of 21 days to be repaired. The department receives ~500 complaints per week during monsoon season with no prioritization system.

title: Mobile Health Clinic Utilization
description: Mobile health clinics operate at 34% capacity on average. Scheduling is manual and communities don't receive timely notifications. Aim is to increase utilization to 75%+.

title: Air Quality Index Monitoring Coverage
description: Only 12% of Delhi wards have functional AQI monitoring stations. Citizens and policymakers lack hyper-local air quality data to act on pollution episodes.
